newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end down due to broker scandal, G7.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end down due to broker scandal, G7.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended with losses on Friday as investors squared positions ahead of the weekend and the G7 summit due to start later in the day, brokers said. They said the scandal involving Japanese brokers and racketeers also hurt the market, pressuring brokerage shares.
The Nikkei average ended 122.31 points or 0.60 percent lower at 20,385.54. Its September futures rose 30 to 20,470.

"The yen was stable around 114 yen to the dollar but with the weekend, G7 about to start and uncertainty over future moves of currencies, investors chose to liquidate longs," Noboru Yorita, general manager at Tachibana Securities, said.
